lede: Texas State carries the stronger underlying team rating — +1.5 against -0.2, a 1.6-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Texas State +2.3 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with North Texas winning 56% of simulations.

Data confidence on this matchup is 41% — enough to publish, not enough to treat the exact margin as settled.
